newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading in Chung Hwa shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Chung Hwa shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd was suspended on Friday at the request of the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said.
It said the company requested the suspension at the request of the SFC pending an announcement.

Chung Hwa said in a statement published on Friday that its controlling shareholder Shimada Ltd, which is owned by Chung Hwa chairman Martin Kwok, bought 38.43 million shares, or 3.5 percent of Chung Hwa, in the open market at HK$1.55 per share on Tuesday.
Shimada then placed 50 million shares, or 4.6 percent, at HK$1.63 per share on Wednesday.
Trading in Chung Hwa shares was suspended on Thursday at the company's request. They last traded at HK$1.70.
